title: A field label rename is saved even though the layout editor says "Layout not saved"
env: staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging) · Setup › Modules & Fields › Tickets · Edge 156, Windows 10

panels.caption: Jam 0:05: the label "test" is renamed on the layout canvas (1).
Jam 0:09: after Save the editor says "Layout not saved" (2), while the field already shows its new label "Email" (3).
Tickets › Fields, checked later: the field is stored as "Email" (4). The rename was saved although the user was told nothing was saved.

rows: Rename a field label on the layout canvas
Click Save when the layout save fails
Nothing is saved and the message says so, or the message lists what was saved
Field label after the failed save
Changed to "Email": the rename is saved before the layout save, and is not rolled back when it fails
"Email" is stored. For about an hour the layout canvas still showed the old "test"
label: BUG
